fields.description: First halfword of the 104-byte block; zero in a fresh image
fields.evidence: FUN_083a3a7a clears slot-relative halfwords during block init (e.g. *(undefined2 *)(iVar5 + 0x26) = 0); baseline block 0 starts with 0x0000 here.
fields.name: block0_base_word

fields.description: First sync word of the per-block 6-byte marker (0xaabb in every populated block)
fields.evidence: FUN_083a3a7a and FUN_083a3a7c step slot state by +0x68 per block and store halfword markers; baseline repeats 0xaabb at raw offsets 0x02, 0x6a, 0xd2, 0x13a.
fields.name: block0_sync_a

fields.description: Second sync word of the per-block marker (0x2200 in every populated block)
fields.evidence: FUN_083a3a7c writes the second marker halfword after the +0x68 stride advance; baseline repeats 0x2200 at raw offsets 0x04, 0x6c, 0xd4, 0x13c.
fields.name: block0_sync_b

fields.description: Third sync word of the per-block marker (0x5544 in every populated block)
fields.evidence: FUN_083a3b6e stores the trailing marker halfword per 0x68-byte block; baseline repeats 0x5544 at raw offsets 0x06, 0x6e, 0xd6, 0x13e.
fields.name: block0_sync_c

fields.description: Config/option flags immediately after the block marker; all clear in a fresh image
fields.evidence: FUN_083a3c62 writes config halfwords at slot-relative offsets after the marker words; baseline holds 0x0000 here while marker words are set.
fields.name: option_flags

fields.description: Gameplay progress counter after the option flags; zero in a fresh image
fields.evidence: FUN_083a3a7a accumulates a per-block counter halfword (extraout_r1 + 0x68 stride) into slot state; baseline holds 0x0000 at this counter slot.
fields.name: progress_counter

fields.description: Zero gameplay payload following the block header; untouched in a fresh image
fields.evidence: FUN_083a3c62 and FUN_083a3b70 leave the payload region after the header words cleared; baseline bytes 0x0c..0x67 are all 0x00.
fields.name: block0_payload

fields.description: Erased EEPROM tail (unwritten 8-byte cells read back as 0xFF)
fields.evidence: FUN_083a4152 block-write loop stops before the tail region; baseline bytes 0x1a0..0x1ff are all 0xFF, the erased EEPROM cell value.
fields.name: erased_tail
